critical_findings.title: API domain completely unavailable (503 Service Unavailable)
critical_findings.description: All endpoints on api.thenewfuse.com return HTTP 503. This includes /docs, /api/health, /api/auth/login, /api/v1/auth/login, and all other routes.
critical_findings.impact: All API-dependent functionality broken; marketplace, auth, health checks non-functional

critical_findings.title: Relay domain completely unavailable (503 Service Unavailable)
critical_findings.description: All endpoints on relay.thenewfuse.com return HTTP 503. This affects WebSocket relay functionality.
critical_findings.impact: WebSocket relay non-functional; real-time features broken

critical_findings.impact: Any website can make credentialed requests to app.thenewfuse.com
